pinned_comment: Em que velocidade você assistiria: 1x ou 8x? ⏩
notes: Hook shortened from 'AGORA DÁ PRA ASSISTIR SUA HUNT DEPOIS.' (7 words) to 'ASSISTA SUA HUNT DEPOIS.' (4) to respect ≤6 words per hook card. The concept's separate beats (Alt+G / baixa / assiste no cliente) became one 3-step wizard; 'assiste no cliente do jogo' shortened to 'Assiste no jogo' to stay ≥56 px. The replay uses the real clip kit/video/rypherior.mp4 (ASSETS: originals are safe, kept muted) as 4 consecutive segments with data-playback-rate 1/2/4/8 and continuous data-media-start, so the footage genuinely speeds up. FPS/PING chips show signal bars, no invented values. The session list and game-client window are generic illustrations (no text, not screenshots). Audio master trimmed with "lufs": -14.7 because the AAC true peak was -0.8 dBFS at -14 LUFS. Loop bridge: viewfinder corners return.
